business.headline: Therapy costs nearly Rs 2,000 a session. Can your health insurance help?Mental health treatment is legally entitled to insurance parity, but therapy claims often fail in practice. The gap usually lies in policy terms that cover hospitalisation or limited app counselling, not regular outpatient sessions.

TVS succession plan sees Venu Srinivasan and Mallika differ over asset ownershipThe main point of disagreement is whether assigning businesses to the next generation also settles the ownership of family wealth.

Why Kolkata has the lowest new housing supply among India's top 7 citiesWhile some of India's biggest cities are seeing a surge in new housing projects, Kolkata is taking a different route. What explains the city's slower pace of new launches?

World growth to slow to 2.6% in 2026 as Middle East crisis hits global economyUNCTAD said global growth could slow to 2.6% in 2026 as the Middle East crisis drives an energy shock. The report also highlighted Asia's growth role, shifting trade flows and AI-linked market risks.

Sensex surges 879 points as IT rally lifts Nifty above 22,500Markets rebounded sharply on Friday, led by IT buying and bargain hunting after Thursday's sell-off. The recovery eased immediate pressure, but crude prices, FII outflows and a weak rupee remain in focus.

IRDAI weighs January or April 2027 start for insurance commission capsIRDAI is considering a January 1 or April 1, 2027 start for insurance commission caps and wider distribution reforms. The proposal has drawn objections over revenue and jobs, while the regulator says it can widen coverage and curb mis-selling.

3 firms got satcom licences, can start ops after clearance: Minister on Starlink rowThe Communications Minister said India does not allow a monopoly in any sector and that the government would enable customers to choose between services in a competitive market.

EPF TDS exemption gets a new form: What changes from tax year 2026-27?If you are planning to withdraw your EPF money, there is a tax-related change you should know about. The new rules for claiming TDS exemption will take effect from tax year 2026-27.

Sensex jumps 1,000 points: 3 reasons why markets are rising todayGive me the latest Sensex and Nifty update in a long line At 2:10 pm, the BSE Sensex was trading 966.32 points higher, up 1.35% at 72,559.56, while the Nifty 50 gained 315.05 points, or 1.42%, to trade at 22,546.85 as the benchmark indices extended their recovery after Thursday's sharp sell-off.

TCS, Infosys, Wipro jump up to 5%: Why IT stocks are rising todayIndian IT stocks rebounded on Friday as investors looked past the immediate impact of US green-card curbs. Company clarifications, dip buying and TCS's AI-led quarterly performance lifted sentiment, though broader market risks remain.

Sensex, Nifty open higher after sharp sell-off; IT stocks lead gainsThe BSE Sensex rose 449.84 points, or 0.63%, to 72,043.08 at 9:32 am. The Nifty 50 gained 150.95 points, or 0.68%, to 22,382.75 at 9:33 am. It opened at 22,314.95 and hit an early high of 22,388.70.

TCS, Infosys, Wipro face US green card curbs: Will IT stocks crash today?For IT stocks, the focus is on two concerns: the potential implications of a US crackdown on the use of foreign workers and signs that demand for technology services remains subdued.
Air India hikes fuel surcharge; domestic up to Rs 1,200, global routes up to 21,000The move comes after IndiGo also revised its fuel surcharge amid heightened pressure on airline fuel expenses.

From scrapping arrest powers to lower penalties: 7 GST Council meet takeawaysFinance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman outlined the key recommendations after the GST Council meeting on Thursday. No GST rates were changed at the meeting.

From litigation to registration and refunds: How GST is changing beyond tax ratesThe Council has proposed a common standard for how a GST notice is issued and served, how a pre-notice intimation is given, when fraud can be alleged, how a hearing is conducted and how an order is written.

GST reforms: Arrest powers scrapped, prosecution limit raised to Rs 5 croreThe GST Council approved wide-ranging compliance reforms, including scrapping arrest powers and raising the prosecution threshold to Rs 5 crore. The changes shift GST 2.0 towards simpler registration, refunds, enforcement and day-to-day business processes.

Gallantt Ispat names Janhvi Kapoor alongside Ajay Devgn as brand ambassadorGallantt Ispat has named Janhvi Kapoor as brand ambassador for Gallantt TMT Bars alongside Ajay Devgn. The move comes as the company prepares for FY2026-27 expansion and a broader national brand push.
TCS Q2 results: Net profit rises 15%, declares Rs 12 interim dividendTCS has declared a second interim dividend of Rs 12 per equity share for the financial year 2026-27.

Investors lose Rs 11.37 lakh crore as Sensex, Nifty fall 1.5%The Sensex ended at 71,593.24, down 1,045.46 points or 1.44%. The index opened at 72,668.00 and touched an intraday low of 71,327.75. The Nifty 50 closed at 22,231.80, down 371.25 points or 1.64%.

Delhi NCR emerges as investor favourite as real estate inflows soar 178%While global economic uncertainty has made investors more cautious, Delhi NCR's real estate market is seeing a strong vote of confidence from institutional investors.

entertainment.headline: Tej Pratap gets emotional as Lalu Yadav, Rabri Devi call him on Rise & Fall 2 Tej Pratap Yadav turned emotional on Rise & Fall Season 2 after Virender Sehwag surprised him with a video call from parents Lalu Prasad Yadav and Rabri Devi. The call brought a heartfelt moment to the show as Tej checked on his father's health.

Kamal Haasan, Chiranjeevi wish Big B on 84th birthday, call him an inspiration Kamal Haasan praised Amitabh Bachchan's iconic baritone and screen presence on his 84th birthday, while Chiranjeevi called him an inspiration and his "Guru Ji". Kamal and Big B are set to reunite in Kalki 2.

Akshay Kumar backs Ganesh Acharya's directorial debut Dust To Stardust, watch trailer Ganesh Acharya has unveiled the trailer of Ganesh Dust To Stardust, his upcoming directorial set for release on 11 December 2026. The film frames a journey of dreams, struggle and sacrifice, with Akshay Kumar calling it Acharya's own story.

Amitabh Bachchan turns 84, fans arrive with posters, songs and birthday jalsa Big B turns 84, and Jalsa is buzzing! Fans brought the beats, dance moves and giant posters to Amitabh Bachchan's birthday bash outside his Mumbai home, proving that the love for the Shahenshah of Bollywood only gets bigger with time.

Kiara Advani's 'mama glow' steals the show in holiday pics with Sidharth Days after announcing her second pregnancy, Kiara Advani shared family holiday pictures with Sidharth Malhotra and their daughter Saraayah. The post drew warm reactions from fans and added a personal note to her latest family update.

Drishyam 3 nears Rs 450 crore worldwide after strong second weekend jump Ajay Devgn's Drishyam 3: The Conclusion has climbed to Rs 446.80 crore worldwide in nine days. The thriller is now the biggest hit of his career and is closing in on the Rs 450 crore mark.

Bigg Boss 20 gets first wild card Manish Goel, second entry teased Salman Khan introduced Manish Goel as Bigg Boss 20's first wild-card contestant during Weekend Ka Vaar. The surprise move jolted the house and sparked fresh buzz over a second entrant.

Imran Khan waves Jai Hind at cops after release from detention, video goes viral Imran Khan's "Jai Hind" shout at police after his release from detention in Mumbai has surfaced in videos from Saturday's anti-CEC protest. In another clip, the actor recounts being driven around in a police van for nearly two hours, questioning why he and other protesters were picked up in the first place.

Nushrratt Bharuccha shares sunset post after spine surgery, promises a comeback Nushrratt Bharuccha has shared her first social media post after suffering a spine injury in Bali. The wheelchair-and-sunset image carried a hopeful note as she said she wants to return in full swing soon.

Salman Khan explains why his new YouTube content may not be for you Salman Khan has introduced his YouTube channel, Being Salman Khan, and says its current content is not meant for adults. The format revisits his screen image through playful acting lessons while adding another digital platform to his line-up.

I certify Rajkummar Rao completely, says Ujjwal Nikam on biopic Prahaar Speaking at India Today Conclave Mumbai 2026, 26/11 trial prosecutor Ujjwal Nikam praised Rajkummar Rao's body language while portraying him in the upcoming biopic Prahaar: The Untold Story of Ujjwal Nikam.

Real names, no glorification: Ujjwal Nikam reveals conditions set for Prahaar makers At the India Today Conclave Mumbai 2026, Ujjwal Nikam revealed the conditions he set for the makers of Prahaar – The Ujjwal Nikam Story. He insisted on no character glorification and the use of real names.

Rajkummar Rao didn't meet Ujjwal Nikam before Prahaar. Here's how he played the role At the India Today Conclave Mumbai 2026, actor Rajkummar Rao said he studied archival footage and gained weight to play Ujjwal Nikam in Prahaar. He said the courtroom scenes were emotionally overwhelming and made the cast feel as if they were reliving the events.

Shobhinaw Satyaa says Captain Smit Machchhar's Hanuman Chalisa act revived faith Hanuman Ansh actor Shobhinaw Satyaa praised Captain Smit Machchhar for reciting the Hanuman Chalisa during a cockpit attack at the India Today Mumbai Conclave 2026. He said the account reinforced faith and showed that acts of courage still endure.

Shobhinaw Satyaa wasn't the first choice for Hanuman Ansh. Here's what changed At India Today Conclave Mumbai 2026, Shobhinaw Satyaa recalled how he went from assistant director to playing Neeb Karoli Baba in Hanuman Ansh. He said the film's success changed his life and drew emotional responses from viewers.

Karan Johar to start another Koffee With Karan-like chat show after finale Karan Johar is reportedly planning a new celebrity chat show after Koffee with Karan ends with Season 9. The filmmaker is exploring an original format under his production banner.

Rishabh Jaiswal to Jashwanth Bopanna, meet Rise and Fall 2's new wildcards Rishabh Jaiswal, Jashwanth Bopanna and Sonam Malik are entering Rise and Fall Season 2 as wildcard contestants. Their arrival comes as Shehzad Poonawalla's calls and nomination clashes unsettle the Tower.

Rajinikanth blown away by Dorothy, his praise leaves Karthik Subbaraj 'flying' Rajinikanth had plenty to say about Dorothy when he met director Karthik Subbaraj and actors Rishikanth and Sananth. He spent an hour discussing the film, with Subbaraj later sharing the superstar's praise online.

Influencer Faisal Shaikh confirms wedding, shares pictures from Madinah nikah Social media influencer Mr Faisu has confirmed his wedding and shared dreamy pictures from his nikah in Madinah, Saudi Arabia. He also asked fans to keep the couple in their prayers as they begin a new chapter.

general news.headline: Delhi Police release video of Dipke being told of grandmother's death in detentionDipke's paternal grandmother, Savitribai Shankarrao Dipke, 85, died after a prolonged illness in Maharashtra's Hingoli district on Saturday.

Power bank catches fire mid-air, Delhi-Chennai IndiGo flight diverted to HyderabadAn IndiGo flight from Delhi to Chennai was diverted to Hyderabad after a passenger's power bank reportedly caught fire onboard. The cabin crew used a fire extinguisher to control the fire. Further details are awaited.

No illegal detention of those gathering peacefully: Supreme Court's big orderThe Supreme Court asked the government to answer claims of illegal detentions and police excess during Delhi protests against CEC Gyanesh Kumar. It ordered a review of barricading, called for normal Metro and rail services unless restrictions are necessary, and issued notices to the Home Secretary, Delhi Police Commissioner and DMRC in contempt proceedings.

Live: CJP didn't follow conditions while seeking nod for protest, says Delhi PoliceCJP Jantar Mantar Protest Live Updates: The Supreme Court on Sunday directed authorities to review all barricading across Delhi, saying peaceful, unarmed protesters cannot be detained except in accordance with the "procedure established by law". It also ordered that metro and railway services operate normally, internet connectivity remain undisturbed and free movement be restored. The directions come amid Saturday's police crackdown on the CJP protest demanding Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's resignation over alleged SIR 'irregularities'. CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke and co-convenors Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka have been released after nearly 24 hours in detention, while Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge said INDIA bloc leaders would meet Chief Justice of India Surya Kant on Monday over the detentions. Delhi Demonstrations are planned in Mumbai and Lucknow as the CJP vows to continue its agitation. I, Prateek Chakraborty, will bring you the latest legal developments, political reactions and ground reports.

Pak imposes emergency in Pathan heartland KP, ousts Imran Khan's last PTI govtPakistan's Shehbaz Sharif government has imposed emergency rule in the Pathan heartland of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, ousting Imran Khan's PTI from its last remaining provincial government amid a planned protest march. The KP governor has warned protesters of an 'iron hand' crackdown, while PTI has condemned the move as undemocratic and warned of further instability.

From new metro links to river linking: CM Vijay lists his demands before PM ModiEarlier in the day, PM Modi inaugurated the 15-km Poonamallee Bypass–Vadapalani section of Chennai Metro's Phase II, built at a cost of around Rs 4,900 crore, and took a train ride with Vijay.

Stay away from Saudi airports: Houthis warn airlines after striking Riyadh airportYemen's Houthis warned airlines, travellers and airport staff to avoid Saudi airports a day after a deadly Houthi strike on Riyadh airport killed 12 people. The warning came as fighting between Saudi forces and Houthis escalated and airport operations were suspended.

Trump tells Ukraine to end refinery attacks, Zelenskyy says Russia must stop tooOn Saturday, Trump blamed Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries for higher US diesel prices and said Zelenskyy had "better damn well stop". He also suggested that Ukraine replace its president, accusing him of missing opportunities to reach a deal with Moscow.

Bouquets, shoes fly as Ajay Rai, Mamta Chaudhary factions clash at Congress eventSupporters of Ajay Rai and Mamta Chaudhary clashed at the Congress headquarters in Lucknow during the charge-taking programme of Aradhana Mishra and Imran Masood. The altercation, marked by slogans, shoes and a scuffle, prompted Rai to seek action against Chaudhary.

UCB Acquires Former The Cube Hotel in £15m Hospitality Education Investment ProgrammeThe acquisition of the former The Cube Hotel and Marco Pierre White restaurant marks the first stage of UCB's wider hospitality investment programme. The site is being redeveloped into a 52-bedroom hotel and restaurant in one of Birmingham's most distinctive landmarks.

Kapil Sibal says he's tired of approaching SC, court vows to win back his faithThe Supreme Court vowed to restore Kapil Sibal's faith in the institution after the senior advocate said at a press conference a day earlier that he was tired of approaching the court and questioned whether there was any point in doing so.

PM launches Chennai Metro stretch worth Rs 4,900 crore, takes ride with CM VijayThe inauguration was part of PM Modi's Chennai visit, during which development projects worth more than Rs 13,000 crore are being inaugurated across transport, highways, ports, petroleum and education. He was accompanied by Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay for many of these events.

Rs 3,000 a gram, peddlers in hiding: Indian stoners panic as weed drought hitsHydroponic cannabis and premium OG Kush have become harder to find in Delhi, Mumbai and Kolkata. With police intensifying checks, the ganja shortage is giving India's underground weed market a serious buzzkill. Is it linked to the crackdown under Union Home Minister Amit Shah's Drug-Free India campaign?

You talk of selling us F-35, but won't let us near one: IAF chief ribs US commanderSpeaking alongside US Pacific Air Forces chief General Kevin Schneider, AP Singh said Washington had made no official offer to sell F-35 jets to India, quipping, "Your people don't even let us go near the aircraft, and you are talking about selling it to us."

CJP's Dipke, Das, Ranka released on condition of maintaining peace for a yearThe three CJP leaders were detained by Delhi Police on Saturday ahead of their planned protest demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. After remaining in detention overnight, they were produced before a court on Sunday morning and subsequently released.

Delhi's detention buses took all, protesters, journalists, even office workersAs police detained protesters in central Delhi, journalists with press IDs and even office workers were put on buses and taken away from central Delhi. The day laid bare how access and movement remained precarious amid barricades, shutdowns and heavy deployment.

At least 109 dead, 116 missing as migrant boat capsizes off Djibouti en route to YemenA boat carrying around 350 migrants from Djibouti to Yemen overturned near Guhere on the night of October 8 and 9. The disaster left at least 109 dead, more than 116 missing and over 80 Ethiopian survivors.

Sent goons to kidnap me: Dhruv Rathee speaks out after release from detentionIn a video statement, Dhruv Rathee also sought to clear up widespread confusion around his citizenship status. He held up an Indian passport as he bashed a section of the mainstream media for spreading what he described as 'rumours' regarding his nationality.

Why US wants to livestream an execution by firing squad for the world to watchThe Pentagon plans to livestream the execution of Nidal Hasan by firing squad at Fort Hood, 17 years after he killed 13 people at the military base. US War Secretary Pete Hegseth has defended the plan as a deterrent, but it has drawn criticism from the Pope, the UN and senators across party lines, with one likening it to executions carried out by the Islamic State (IS).

From IIT Kanpur to Jantar Mantar: CJP's Ashutosh Ranka had done it beforeFormer IIT Kanpur director Indranil Manna recalled a three-day confrontation with student leader Ashutosh Ranka after a student's death on campus. He said the episode showed why institutes must hear protests but act on inquiry-led facts, not crowd pressure.

He started with Physical Science. Now, IIT Madras student eyes AI research in JapanIIT Madras BS student Shudhanshu Kumar Yadav, who began with Physical Science and little coding experience, has secured internships in India and selections at the University of Tokyo and GCI World 2026. His journey shows structured learning and steady effort can open AI research paths.

From university classrooms to student politics: Here's Neha Bora's academic journeyNeha Bora's public profile brings together her JNU research and her role as AISA national president. Her trajectory links academic work in performance studies with student campaigns on education and rights.

sports.headline: PM Modi to host Asian Games medallists, cricketers on October 15 Prime Minister Narendra Modi will meet India's Asian Games contingent, cricketers and other medallists at his residence on October 15 at 4:30 pm. The meeting will bring together athletes who have represented the country and won medals in sport.

Asian Games Gold Medallists On Relay Win, Hockey Glory And Nari Shakti Asian Games gold medallists Kiran, Prachi, and Navneet reflected on their historic victories and personal journeys at a special panel. Relay runners Kiran and Prachi, alongside teammates Vidya and Poovamma, reclaimed gold in the women's 4x400 metre relay, edging out China. Prachi shared how the team united from different states as one India, determined to raise the tricolour and play the national anthem. She also recalled having her police uniform measurements taken in anticipation of a deputy superintendent post pledged for gold winners. Kiran recounted her journey overcoming social discouragement and financial hardship by working shifts at a store to fund her athletics training. Indian women's hockey vice-captain Navneet highlighted the team's decisive gold victory against higher-ranked China, which confirmed qualification for the Los Angeles Olympics following the heartbreak of missing Paris. Navneet also made an appeal for sponsors to revive the Women's Hockey League.

3rd T20I Live Score: India look to recover in Indore after Ranchi runfest India (IND) vs West Indies (WI) 3rd T20I Live Updates: After the 501-run match in Ranchi, Shreyas Iyer's India will be desperate to draw level in the series in Indore.

Udhayveer Sidhu beats Olympic medallist Reitz to win gold in ISSF World Cup India's Udhayveer Sidhu won gold in the men's 10m air pistol event at the ISSF World Cup Rifle/Pistol on Sunday, finishing with a score of 240.6 to beat Germany's Christian Reitz by 0.5 points. Udhayveer had earlier qualified for the final in fourth place with a score of 585-19x.

Sobhana Mostary becomes first Bangladesh woman with century vs Australia Sobhana Mostary made history by becoming the first Bangladesh woman to score an ODI century against Australia, smashing 118 off 134 balls in Brisbane. Her record 195-run partnership with Nigar Sultana Joty helped Bangladesh recover from 8/3, although Australia won by nine wickets.

Smith rewrites Test record books, surpasses Root for most catches as fielder Steve Smith surpassed Joe Root to become the leading catcher among fielders in Test cricket, taking his tally to 221 catches against South Africa in Durban. However, after scoring just 25 in Australia's first innings, Smith will be looking to make amends with the bat in the second innings.

Smriti Mandhana joins UNICEF family, Sachin Tendulkar backs her mission for children Smriti Mandhana has joined UNICEF India as a celebrity advocate, pledging to promote children's rights, gender equality and equal opportunities for young girls, with Sachin Tendulkar welcoming her appointment.

NZ vs IND: Coach Rob Walter explains split ODI squads, Finn Allen's new role New Zealand have split their squad for the ODI series against India to give Test players time to prepare for the red-ball series and test their squad depth ahead of the 2027 ODI World Cup.

Vaibhav Sooryavanshi is an 'unreal talent': India wonderkid praised by NZ pacer Lockie Ferguson said he is looking forward to bowling to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi in New Zealand. The series will test whether the 15-year-old can carry his early promise into unfamiliar conditions.

Matt Renshaw breaks Virat Kohli's decade-old record in Test cricket Matt Renshaw broke Virat Kohli's decade-old record for the most runs scored alongside tail-enders in a Test innings, scoring 174 runs with the lower order during his career-best 190 off 397 balls against South Africa in Durban.

AFG vs BAN: Hasan Mahmud becomes first Bangladesh pacer to take a Test hat-trickBangladesh pacer Hasan Mahmud made history on Sunday, October 11, becoming the first fast bowler from the country to take a Test hat-trick. The 26-year-old dismissed Ismat Alam, Qais Ahmad and Zia-ur-Rehman in consecutive deliveries on Day 3 of the one-off Test against Afghanistan in Abu Dhabi.

From U-17 World Cup to Brazil: Indian football's cycle of hopeNearly nine years after the Under-17 World Cup, a return to Salt Lake Stadium as a journalist brought back old memories and new questions about Indian football. The big nights still arrive, but can the game build on them once the spotlight fades?

Ranji Trophy: Jaiswal gets duck, Rahul falls cheaply as India Test stars struggleYashasvi Jaiswal was dismissed for a duck, while KL Rahul managed just four runs as India's Test openers suffered a poor start to the Ranji Trophy 2026-27 season on Sunday.

Arunachal Pradesh forfeit Ranji Trophy opener after state cricket body crisisArunachal Pradesh forfeited their Ranji Trophy Plate Group opener against Nagaland amid an administrative dispute in the state cricket association. A court stay has left the body without a functioning authority, preventing the BCCI from intervening.

A teddy lover, foodie and milkman: India's new-gen wrestlers beyond the medalsIndia's wrestling contingent returned with six medals from the 2026 Asian Games, its best haul since 1962. New Zealand to wear special ODI jersey marking 100 years of ties with IndiaNew Zealand will sport a special jersey featuring Indian and Maori designs during their ODI series against India in November, as the two countries celebrate 100 years of sporting ties.

When paper planes stopped football: Rayo Vallecano vs Athletic abandoned after protestsRayo Vallecano's home match against Athletic Bilbao was abandoned after supporters twice threw paper planes and rubber balls on to the pitch. The protest, aimed at president Raul Martin Presa, sharpened attention on the club's stadium and management troubles.

Hockey India turmoil: Gold medals mask a growing administrative crisisIndia's men's and women's hockey teams have delivered historic Asian Games gold medals despite growing turmoil within Hockey India. But behind the success, a bitter power struggle, administrative uncertainty and a stalled league threaten the sport's long-term health.

Vaibhav Sooryavanshi is like me, says Sehwag on fearless batting approachVirender Sehwag has backed Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's fearless batting approach, drawing comparisons with his own attacking style as the 15-year-old waits for an opportunity in India's ongoing T20I series against the West Indies.

Vinicius apologises after red card: Could Real Madrid star miss El Clasico?Vinicius Junior apologised to Real Madrid fans and teammates after his red card against Villarreal, but the controversy adds to a difficult season for the Brazilian. After 500-run thriller, India's bowlers brace for another tough night in IndoreIND vs WI 3rd T20I: India's bowlers face another stern test against West Indies in the third T20I at Indore's batting-friendly Holkar Stadium. Ronaldo wanted back by Portugal despite disciplinary proceedings over camp exitPortugal want Cristiano Ronaldo back despite opening disciplinary proceedings against the captain over his departure from the national team camp. Ronaldo has apologised and remains available for selection, with his punishment yet to be decided.

Kumkum Mohod returns after Asian Games gold as Chero Archers fall in APL thrillerKumkum Mohod returned after her Asian Games gold-medal run as Chero Archers suffered their first Archery Premier League defeat, losing to Prithviraaj Yodhas after a dramatic sudden-death shoot-off in Hyderabad.

Shubman Gill to miss Punjab's Ranji Trophy season openerShubman Gill will miss Punjab's opening Ranji Trophy match against Assam but could feature against Chhattisgarh from October 18. The India captain may use the fixture to gain match practice ahead of the team's tour of New Zealand.

Verstappen seals sprint win, takes pole in Singapore as Antonelli extends title leadMax Verstappen won the Singapore Grand Prix sprint and secured his 50th career pole, while Kimi Antonelli extended his championship lead over George Russell to 89 points ahead of Sunday's race.

South Africa reached 27 for one in reply before bad light halted play, leaving Australia with the upper hand.

KKR coach warns Gautam Gambhir's constant changes could hurt India's consistencyKKR coach Shane Watson believes Gautam Gambhir's constant chopping and changing is preventing India from reaching their full potential. Coco Gauff faces racial abuse at China Open, UN Human Rights condemns attacksThe UN Human Rights office condemned the racist online abuse directed at Coco Gauff following a controversial point in her China Open win over Sun Xinran. Sehwag sees a reflection of himself in Sooryavanshi: His thinking is similar to mineVirender Sehwag sees his fearless, attack-from-the-first-ball approach in teenage sensation Vaibhav Sooryavanshi and believes performance, not age, should determine a player's place in Indian cricket.
